metadata.source: Standard Exam Simulations for SBI Clerk, IBPS Clerk, and RRB OA Mains

mock_tests.title: SBI Clerk (Junior Associate) Mains - Full Mock 1
mock_tests.description: Exact replica of the General/Financial Awareness section of SBI Clerk Mains, featuring RBI circulars, latest schemes, payment limits, and tricky factual traps.

mock_tests.title: IBPS Clerk (Customer Service Associate) Mains - Full Mock 1
mock_tests.description: Standard IBPS Clerk Mains simulation with mandatory sectional cutoff (15.0 Marks). Tests precision under time pressure and elimination technique.

mock_tests.title: IBPS RRB Office Assistant (Multipurpose) Mains - Full Mock 1
mock_tests.description: Specialized rural banking simulation for RRB Office Assistant Mains with emphasis on NABARD, KCC, Priority Sector Lending, RRBs, and financial inclusion.
